OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER HARVESTING - Saguday
Operation: manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field
Why defer: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment; rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk.
ACAP calendar: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Maturing.
LGU/MAO action: defer harvest or machine entry until fields can carry workers and equipment safely; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Harvesting - Saguday: Please defer manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field for now. Reason: recent rainfall can cause soil compaction, rutting, or poor crop establishment. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Maturing. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

texts.bulletin: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Saguday: Do not apply pesticides or foliar fertilizers in rainy conditions. Rain within 4–6 hours of application will wash off chemicals, reducing efficacy and increasing environmental contamination risk. Reschedule spraying to early morning hours on clear days.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not spray pesticides when raining. Reschedule to clear morning. Saves money, protects water.
